name: The Highest Ever Mountain
desc:
Are you brave enough to reach the top of the highest MOUNTAIN ever?

Climb the BIGGEST MOUNTAIN to come back down with the craziest sports like Snowboarding or Gliding! ⭐

⚡️  Premium benefits: Premium players get free +5 speed   ⚡️ 

Make sure to CLIMB multiple times by rebirthing to unlock cooler Extreme SPORTS!
